title: Billing Submit Label
prompt: A React billing form changes its submit button text while saving. Write a helper that returns "Saving..." when saving is true and "Save" otherwise.

explanation.beginner:
Example: billingSubmitLabel(true) produces "Saving...". Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Compare “shows default text”: input [false] produces "Save". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Tempting mistake: Capitalization, whitespace, and boolean-versus-string output are part of the contract; truthiness alone may combine distinct states.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “shows default text”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
